Printing the book

The print edition uses a 6 × 9 inch page. Print at 100% on matching stock, duplex with long-edge binding, or ask a print shop to impose and trim it to that size. For A4 or Letter home printing, choose fit-to-page and expect a different finished size. This is a reading edition, not a printer-specific press-ready PDF.
